login.title: A clearer view of the work behind every order.
login.description: Sales, inventory and finance in one working view. Sign in with a demo role to explore the Atlas operation.
login.passwordNote: Demo accounts are read-only where their role requires it.
login.subtitle: Wholesale distribution · Casablanca, Morocco
login.resetNotice: No signup. Demo data resets to its baseline.
login.error: We couldn't sign in. Check that the local database is seeded, then try again.

dashboard.title: Good morning, {name}
dashboard.subtitle: Here’s the latest from Atlas Trading Co.
dashboard.dashboardPrinciple: Reliable numbers start with a clear chain of records.
dashboard.productsDescription: A live view of active items across the Atlas warehouses.
dashboard.empty: No products found. Run the seed command to load the demo catalogue.
dashboard.comingViews: Inventory data is live; sales and finance views arrive in upcoming milestones.

copilot.title: Copilot is planned
copilot.description: The data assistant is intentionally paused while the core ERP is built. No AI service or runtime is connected.
copilot.futureDescription: At project completion, we’ll review the value, hosting options and ongoing cost before deciding whether to activate it.

orders.title: Sales orders
orders.subtitle: Create and track the path from order to payment.
orders.editDraftHelp: Draft changes are locked when the order is confirmed.
orders.createHelp: Select the customer, fulfilment warehouse, and first product line.
orders.listDescription: Each order advances through guarded business actions.
orders.empty: No orders yet. Create a draft to start the order workflow.
orders.timelineDescription: Recorded transitions from the order service.
orders.actionGuardrail: Each step validates permissions, stock, and current status.
orders.noActions: This role can view this order but cannot advance it.
orders.paymentNote: Recording a payment updates the demo ledger only; no money is processed.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the order details and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot perform that action.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The order could not be found.
errors.CONFLICT: The order changed or the request was repeated. Refresh and try again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: There is not enough stock to ship this order.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: That action is not available at this order stage.
errors.INTERNAL: The action could not be completed. Try again.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: The accounts and relationships behind Atlas orders.
customers.ledgerTitle: A working view of the customer book
customers.ledgerDescription: Browse customer accounts, commercial terms, and their recent order activity.
customers.listDescription: Search by customer or city, then narrow the ledger by segment.
customers.invalidFiltersHelp: Use a supported segment, a search of 80 characters or fewer, and a page from 1 to 1,000.
customers.empty: No customers match. Try another name, city, or segment.
customers.historyDescription: Recent orders associated with this customer.
customers.noOrders: No orders have been recorded for this customer.
customers.recentOrdersOnly: Showing the {count} most recent of {total} orders.
customers.footerNote: Customer and order details are scoped to your organization.

quotes.title: Sales quotes
quotes.subtitle: Shape a commercial offer, record the decision, then carry its terms into an order.
quotes.newQuoteHelp: Start with one product line. Prices are captured from the catalogue and remain fixed after sending.
quotes.quoteListDescription: Track offers from draft through acceptance and order conversion.
quotes.empty: No quotes match these filters. Create a draft to prepare an offer.
quotes.ledgerSummaryDescription: Every quote preserves the products, quantities, and prices offered to a customer.
quotes.validityHelp: This offer can be accepted through the date shown.
quotes.expiredOn: This offer expired on {date}. It can no longer be accepted.
quotes.validForNewQuote: Choose today or a later date. A sent quote cannot be edited.
quotes.noLines: This quote has no product lines.
quotes.editDraftHelp: The offer is locked once it is sent.
quotes.issueHelp: Sending records when the offer became active; it does not email a customer.
quotes.acceptHelp: Record an acceptance received outside this demo.
quotes.convertHelp: Creates an editable draft order with the exact prices captured in this quote.
quotes.noActions: This role can view the quote but cannot change it.
quotes.timelineDescription: Recorded decisions from the quote service.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the quote details and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot perform that quote action.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The quote could not be found.
errors.CONFLICT: The quote changed or the request was repeated. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: That action is no longer available for this quote.
errors.INTERNAL: The quote action could not be completed. Try again.

quotes.footerNote: Sending a quote records a business event only; no email is sent.
